The Spanish DIVERGES in meaning on two items: Constru1 'Prefieres decir lo que estás pensando, incluso si es inadecuado para la situación' (say what you are thinking even if it is inappropriate for the situation) vs English 'express your thoughts and feelings openly, even if it may sometimes cause conflict'; Constru11 'Te ves a ti mismo/a diferente en diferentes ambientes sociales' (in different social environments) vs English 'when you are with different people'. Disclosed in public_note. No Spanish .docx exists on the ISP Self-construal component (33 languages, none Spanish), so the Spanish translator is not recorded; for the other ISP measures it is this paper's authors Gallardo-Pujol and Oceja. Verified: r(Constru1, BFI1 outgoing) +.23, r(Constru7, BFI2 compassionate) +.27, r(Constru8, BFI2) -.12; Constru7 'look after close people' mean 6.77 with nobody at 1 (reversed reading 3.23). The postprint's phrase 'keyed from Describes me exactly to Does not describe me at all' is only a listing order. Paper-level oddity, not an IRW defect: the authors' Self-Expression score reverses items 1 and 4 (the self-expression items), so it is scored harmony-high despite the paper saying high scores mean independence -- consistent with its reported Extraversion r = -.32. Every item uses all nine levels except Constru7 (no 1s; 2..9). (5) RIGHTS: register verdict applied, not re-derived -- instrument_rights_register.csv 'Self-construal items, Vignoles et al. Content predictions hold: the only first-person item ('Generalmente, confío en los demás') is Trust4, the most endorsed (mean 3.43 vs 2.71-3.25) and the only one with a non-trivial ceiling (8.6% vs 1.0-1.9%); 'La mayoría de la gente confía en los demás' (the only item about others' trusting rather than trustworthiness) is Trust3, the weakest-linked (mean r .247 vs .379-.444); honest/good-natured (Trust1-Trust2) is the strongest pair (r .589). These are post-hoc readings, and nothing separates Trust1 from Trust2. Direction: same export's IHS reproduces published M 3.49/SD .54 (3.488/.541) so 1 = Totalmente en desacuerdo; display-order preservation corroborated on sibling scales (Constru 6/6, 10/10, 6/6; LOT 15/15). The register's basis is SILENCE, not a positive grant: no originator or distributor terms were located, so there is no caution clause to quote. Re-checked 2026-09-24: OSF node dsz43 returns node_license null; the Spanish docx carries only the NSF acknowledgement.
